data.name: Harmonia
data.gender_notes: Harmonia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Harmonia was the goddess of harmony and concord. She was the wife of Cadmus, the founder of Thebes. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'harmonia', meaning 'harmony, concord'. The name Harmonia carries the meaning “Harmony, concord” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Harmonia usually hope their child will grow to embody harmony, concord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes harmony and unity in relationships and spiritual practices.
data.etymology: Harmonia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Harmony, concord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Harmonia total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: הרמוניה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הרמוניה היא שם שמקורו ביוונית, אך יש לו השפעה והתייחסות גם בעברית. הוא מתאר אחדות, שלום והתאמה בין היסודות השונים. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם הרמוניה מייצג את הרעיון של התאמה והרמוניה בין אלוהים לאדם, ובין בני האדם זה לזה. השם מופיע גם בכתבי הקודש ומתאר את היופי והאחדות של הבריאה.

in_greek.name: Αρμονία
in_greek.long_meaning: Αρμονία είναι το όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη για την αρμονία, που σημαίνει συμφωνία, ομόνοια και ευρυθμία. Στο χριστιανικό πλαίσιο, το όνομα Αρμονία αντιπροσωπεύει την ιδέα της αρμονίας και της συμφωνίας μεταξύ του Θεού και του ανθρώπου, και μεταξύ των ανθρώπων. Το όνομα αυτό ήταν γνωστό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και είχε σχέση με την μυθολογία και την πολιτιστική κληρονομιά.

in_latin.name: Harmonia
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Harmonia in lingua Latina significat concordiam, harmoniam et unitatem. In traditione christiana, nomen Harmonia refert ad ideam concordiae et harmoniae inter Deum et hominem, et inter homines. Nomen hoc usitatum est in ecclesia primitiva et habet profundam significationem spiritualem.

in_english.name: Harmonia
in_english.long_meaning: The name Harmonia originates from Greek mythology and signifies unity, concord, and harmony. In Christian tradition, Harmonia represents the concept of harmony and unity between God and humanity, and among people. The name has been used across various Christian cultures and holds significant spiritual meaning, symbolizing peace, balance, and coherence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Harmonia embodies the concept of unity and harmony, not only in terms of relationships but also in the larger societal context. In the ancient Greek civilization, Harmonia was considered the patroness of marriages and festivals, reflecting the importance of unity and harmony in preserving social order and promoting social cohesion. This name conveys a sense of balance and peace, and is a reminder that even in the midst of Chaos, there can be Harmony.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Harmonia represents the harmonious balance of the universe, and the interconnectedness of all things. It serves as a reminder of the importance of peace, love, and unity in our personal lives and in our relationship with the Divine. The name Harmonia is a call to seek inner harmony, and to strive for unity and concord in our actions, thoughts, and emotions. It is a symbol of the beauty and power of the harmonious balance of the universe, and a reminder that even in the midst of chaos, we can find inner peace and harmony.
